what: Hybrid router: the real arm always runs local; Dream drives only the sim arms
why: The pitch's v2 says Dream-1 no longer drives the real robot, so the code and the hybrid design now say the same thing.
details: Removed the dream_on_real override from ExecutorRouter; on the real arm it always picks the local taught-pose routine with the detector for the last centimetre. The 850 ms Dream-or-local rule now applies to the sim only. Vision tests pass.
